name: Additional materials dataset discoveries
coverage_notes: 50 new source-backed records were selected beyond the 304-record baseline. Searches cover defects/disorder, porous/adsorption, specialized functional/low-dimensional materials, and atomistic/experimental property collections.
Every official route from the new records and every public URL from the four topical lead ledgers is preserved. This is a bounded search inventory, not a census of the internet.

Parent datasets, variants, measured observations, calculated frames, generated structures and predicted properties remain distinguishable. Unverified counts/licenses and restricted access remain explicit.
All work stays local until the user authorizes publishing.

links.label: uMOF
links.treatment: Article claims 85,524 r2SCAN-D4 configurations and 3,986 property records, but totals conflict: 19,950 parent frameworks in abstract versus 21,519 in split section; no independent dataset release payload/rights verified. ml-peg benchmark is described as forthcoming.

links.label: Genomic COF database
links.treatment: Primary paper describes approximately 470k hypothetical COFs and links a GSU building-block library, but data availability says corresponding authors upon request. A live release of all coordinates and data rights was not independently established; secondary review exact 471,990 not promoted.

links.label: Genomic MOF database
links.treatment: QMOF source provenance references historical Figshare shared link and gmof identifiers; parent release metadata/count/rights not independently verified; QMOF changelog warns of missing H atoms in many original parents.

links.label: ACS MOF thermal stability 2022 supporting workbook
links.treatment: Actual CC BY-NC 4.0 workbook payload has only correlation_raw with descriptor names/correlations; 1,593 matrix rows are not MOF measurements. Do not rank as a 1,593-material corpus.

links.label: MOFTransformer CoRE/QMOF embeddings
links.treatment: Embeddings and energy grids are derivative representations of existing CoRE and QMOF parents. Separate 1,118,074-structure hypothetical pretraining release promoted.

links.label: MOF experimental CAU-10/MIL-96 hydrothermal stability
links.treatment: Provider describes eight CC BY 4.0 experimental isotherm/PXRD/QE-TPDA workbooks for two framework families; useful small stability benchmark but sample/measurement counting and overlap not audited.

links.label: Crystallite-size water intrusion/extrusion data
links.treatment: Experimental MOF TEM/XRD/high-pressure water porosimetry archive found. Record scope and unique samples not yet inspected.

links.label: COF-999 direct-air-capture data
links.treatment: Primary paper provides experimental source data and computational Zenodo13382234; coordinates/count units and release rights not independently audited.

links.label: COF space gas adsorption benchmark
links.treatment: Primary article names GitHub gokhanonderaksu/COFSpace input/target tables from existing CoRE/HypoCOF parents. Distinct property layer may merit promotion after release/label inspection.

links.label: ReDD-COFFEE carbon capture HTS 2024
links.treatment: Repository describes GCMC results and broader ML predictions for ReDD-COFFEE parents. Existing parent already cataloged; new label counts/rights not audited.

links.label: MOFinder
